note: The closed page-class list and the route -> class routing table. Canon: design_system/public/PAGE_PLAN.md. Read by scripts/check-page-plan.mjs (ci:page-plan). A class owns the spine; a route may ADD to it, never silently drop from it. `spine: []` means the class has not been ground yet - ci:page-plan reports it, and /site-consistency fills it one class at a time. Do NOT invent a spine here without working the class's real pages; a speculative spine is the drift this file exists to stop.

home.job: Orient, then route to a job: buy, sell, or look.

inventory.opens: Field (Ledger register on the search surfaces)

place.opens: per grain - PUBLIC_UI.md section 3 per-destination openings table

market.job: Understand the market: present, past, and what it means.

seller.job: Get the number, decide whether to sell.
seller.opens: Stage then Sheet (the address field is the spine)

guide.job: Understand the area around the house.

brokerage.job: Decide whether to trust this shop with the largest transaction of their life.

spine.why: ONE structured-data chokepoint for the class. Measured 2026-09-05: /about and /team emit through MetadataBlock, /reviews through a bespoke reviews-jsonld.ts, and /contact and /videos hand-roll raw <script type="application/ld+json" dangerouslySetInnerHTML> tags in the page body (three and four of them respectively). Three emission paths in one class is how the markup drifts from the visible copy - the neighborhood contract already states the house rule: one derivation feeds both.
The up-rung. Carried by all seven brokerage pages already; the spine records it so it cannot be lost.

A trust class must show proof. Measured 2026-09-05: /join, /contact, /refer-a-client and /videos carry no V3Proof - four of seven pages whose whole job is deciding whether to trust this shop. A waiver is available and must name why this page is the exception.

The outbound edges and the FAQ. Either primitive satisfies it: V3Answers superseded the closing V3Quiet on 2026-09-02 (the about contract records the swap - 1,491px of prose with no figure and no control is the wall of text TASTE.md bans). A trust page that dead-ends is a dead end in the exploration graph (PRODUCT.md job 2).

mustAnswer: Who are these people and can I see their faces?
What have they actually done - how many sales, how long, licensed as what?
Where do they work, and do they know MY area?
What do their past clients say?
How do I reach a human right now?

tool.job: Compute one thing and understand the answer.

capture.job: Convert a campaign click. Paid traffic, not organic.
capture.benchmarkExemptReason: Paid and campaign landing pages are measured by conversion rate in the ad platform, not by organic SERP position against a rival page. Their competitive test lives in the Meta/Google campaign, not here.

system.job: A utility the site needs. Not a content page and not a destination.
system.benchmarkExemptReason: Legal, unsubscribe, offline, feed, dev sandboxes and token-gated surfaces carry no organic intent. There is no rival page to beat.
